AST, executable, full regression and browser checks provide separate verification. This is not a new derivation of every theorem or a fresh external-reference audit.

reviewedBatches.scopeAndLimits: Moving contact-window crossings and distributional sources; reversed ideal-gas shocks preserve jump conservation but reverse admissibility. No resolved shock structure.

Fixed-kernel ballistic third moments and mean/dispersion exchange; anisotropic paired Poisson parents, marginal Poisson counts versus dependent windows. No irreversible heating or local-equilibrium certificate.
Normal-stress inverse conditioning and null directions; finite metric compatibility versus global injectivity. No instrument or constitutive stability certificate.
Incoming characteristics and speed-weighted full-state boundary norms; two-solution error energy and transient initial growth versus a conservative envelope. No general 3D regularity assertion.
Added local-equilibrium entropy relation and availability units; moving-reference Gaussian KL versus persistent center/mass error. Zero mass stays undefined.

Positive-rate spatial species mixtures and conditional information; Gaussian KPP upper comparison and separate compact lower bump. No inference of nonlinear invasion from an upper bound or saturation from a ray lower bound.
Periodic frequency fits versus internal Maxwell-spectrum nonuniqueness; full-invariant invisible uniaxial energy and small-shear sensitivity. No general multiaxial stability claim.
Physical versus signed cell Peclet, centered negative nodes and fitted steady nodal exactness; finite Robin supply, Biot number and inverse-rate ambiguity. No arbitrary transient certification.
Reciprocal availability versus complete relaxation and persistent zero controls; fixed-reservoir ideal-leg load power versus efficiency. No manufactured-device guarantee.
Complete steady forced mean/fluctuation work and signed transfer; nested Gaussian positive stresses versus noncommuting signed transfer. Not a turbulent cascade or full LES.

Volume-invariant stochastic semigroup and convex entropies versus Euler positivity; spatial quadratic entropy flux versus finite-step correction. Undefined negative-state KL and separate zero inventories preserved.
